challenges.name: Source Hunt
challenges.description: A small starter web challenge. Read the page, follow the hint, and find the flag.
command:
cat <<'EOF' > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html Source Hunt

Source Hunt

This is a simple learning challenge.

Start by reading the page source. If that does not help, check the usual web files.

EOF cat <<'EOF' > /usr/share/nginx/html/robots.txt User-agent: * Disallow: /flag.txt EOF nginx -g 'daemon off;'
